mapper.select: select o.organization_id id, o.name from b_organization o, r_user_tenant rut where o.flag = 1 and rut.flag = 1 and o.organization_id = rut.organization_id and rut.user_id = #{userId}
select a.* from b_organization a JOIN r_user_tenant b ON b.organization_id = a.organization_id JOIN b_user c ON c.user_id = b.user_id where b.flag =1 and c.flag = 1 and c.user_id = #{userId}
select name AS label, organization_id AS value from b_organization where flag != -1 and parameter ->> "$.serviceType" != 0 and tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select ad.organization_id, ad.full_name as full_name, ad.service_type as service_type, ad.label as type, ad.filepath as filepath from b_organization a ,b_organization_detail ad where a.flag = 1 and a.organization_id = ad.organization_id and ad.service_type != 0 and a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by ad.service_type, a.create_time asc
select level from b_organization where flag = 1 and tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by level asc limit 1

select bo.name, bo.level, bo.tenant_id, user_cn, user_mobile, user_org_name_full_path from b_organization bo join iam_user iu on instr(iu.user_org_name_full_path, bo.name) > 0 where bo.flag = 1 and bo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and iu.user_mobile = #{userMobile} order by user_cn, bo.level desc limit 1
